# agents/mantle (Inspector e2e, skill-mode)

**Pinned copy** of `examples/mantle-banking` — a hybrid Mantle agent (six skills
combining LLM-driven phases, ordered blocks, and tool calls). It backs the
Inspector NextGen Playwright suite's skill-mode coverage (`tests/mantle/`), which
the v1 finance agent under `agents/calm/` cannot exercise (`skill_state` is emitted only
by the Mantle processor).

Pinned rather than referenced so the e2e agent stays stable and self-contained
(matching how `agents/calm/` is a pinned fork of the finance template) — do not treat it
as a live mirror of `examples/mantle-banking`.

`scripts/e2e-setup.sh` trains this agent and serves it with `rasa inspect` on
**:5006**; `tests/mantle/` target it with `test.use({ baseURL: MANTLE_BASE_URL })`. The
finance agent stays on :5005.
